tagline: Keeping networks reliable. Solving technical problems. Building useful tools.
introduction: I work in network operations and technical support, with practical exposure to ISP billing systems, Linux environments, connectivity troubleshooting, and database operations. I also build personal projects to strengthen my software and infrastructure skills.
about: My professional work focuses on supporting ISP operations, investigating technical issues, monitoring network connectivity, and helping customers resolve service-related problems.
Outside daily support work, I explore Linux administration, Oracle SQL, Docker, virtualization, and automation through practical projects and a personal lab.
